verdict.rationale: First-party docs say Muse keeps working on delegated goals and tasks after you close the app. It runs on a schedule and in response to events, takes the next step, and follows up with a notification when your attention is needed. Tasks are tracked in a Goals tab, with approval cards and a full activity log and audit trail for review. Multi-step examples such as planning and booking a whole trip back this up. The community stress-test reports control-plane timeouts under load but does not show background tasks failing to work as claimed. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of background task completion, and detailed docs on how a completed multi-step result is handed back for review.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can delegate a multi-step task that the assistant works on autonomously in the background and returns for my review

citations.quote: Once you've set a goal or a task, Muse continues to work on a schedule and in response to relevant events, taking the next step and following up
Muse keeps things moving after you close the app. It monitors, follows up, and sends a notification when something needs your attention
The Goals tab is where Muse keeps track of all this for you, and you can interact directly there or talk to it about these tasks in chat.
Muse shows people a complete audit trail of everything it has done and plans to do.
structured approval cards with clear accept/reject actions
